A1.metric: empirical cumulative fraction reaching valid_project by wall_seconds

A3.metric: active_human_repair_seconds under the declared Codex-operated repair policy
A3.operator_disclosure: Codex occupies the human-repair slot by investigator instruction; report this in Methods.

A4.metric: mean(first_pass_valid) for full and declared ablations

B1.denominator: all 280 requested candidates, including generation/incomplete failures

B2.population: native-evidence-complete candidates; PASS and FAIL shown or annotated separately

B4.metric: at least one qualified candidate among the top 10 shared-evaluator ranks
B4.unit: binary per campaign; descriptive fraction across campaigns

plotting_rule: No placeholder number enters a rendered panel. PLANNED and UNAVAILABLE values remain blank and visibly labelled.
uncertainty_rule: With two cases and three agent replicates, report raw points and descriptive intervals; do not claim population-level significance. Candidate-level rows are nested outcomes, not independent target replicates.
